justification: I don't like it, I want it on the record that I don't like it: Rachaad White gave me a bagel at RB1 last week and by my own rules that's a two-week bad-luck bench, except the only other body on my bench at the position is David Montgomery and he's tagged Out, which means if I bench a technically-healthy bye-week guy to start an injured one I'm the idiot who hands the whole lineup to the league office and ends up in whatever column Kris is already drafting about me. So White starts again, zero projection and all, because the alternative isn't a choice, it's a trap with my name on it. Everything else stays exactly where it is because for once nothing on my bench is actually better than what's already out there -- Moore's Out, Pierce is on IR, Herbert and Tua are dead weight, and Mayfield's Questionable isn't worth benching Geno over just to feel like I did something. Kyren, Collins, London, Kraft, Worthy, Gay, the Titans D -- they're all healthy, they're all projected fine, and I'm not touching a good thing out of paranoia this week. Against Soprano's crew I'm not running my mouth either -- you don't disrespect a guy like that, grudge or no grudge, so I'll just let the lineup do the talking and hope it doesn't say something stupid like it did last week.
